def __init__(self, width=512, blocks=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.register_buffer("x_mean", torch.zeros(51))
        self.register_buffer("x_std", torch.ones(51))
        self.register_buffer("c_mean", torch.zeros(54))
        self.register_buffer("c_std", torch.ones(54))
        self.inp = nn.Linear(51 + 54 + 64, width)

def forward(self, x, t, c):
        xn = (x - self.x_mean) / self.x_std
        cn = (c - self.c_mean) / self.c_std
        h = torch.cat([xn, cn, sinusoidal(t)], dim=1)
        return self.out(self.blocks(self.inp(h))) * self.x_std
